note: Known national and annual campaigns. Rules generate the dates for any year; confirmed entries override a rule for one year. Rules marked estimate follow the pattern of recent years and should be checked each year. Draft values may use the tokens listed in docs/CAMPAIGNS.md. Run npm run docs after editing.

campaigns.name: Mild Month
campaigns.summary: CAMRA's month-long celebration of mild every May: make yours a Mild this May. Branches run mild trails and pubs put a mild on the bar.

values.note: Make yours a Mild this May.

values.heading: Make yours a Mild this May
values.note: Ask for a mild at the bar all month.

values.heading: Last week of Mild Month
values.note: There is still time to make yours a mild.

values.heading: Thanks for drinking mild
values.note: Thank you to every pub that put a mild on the bar this May.

campaigns.name: Cider and Perry Month
campaigns.summary: CAMRA's month-long celebration of real cider and perry, held every July since 2025 (it used to run in May and October). Ask for #NotFromConcentrate real cider or perry.

values.note: A month of real cider and perry at your local.

values.heading: Cider and Perry Month
values.note: Ask for #NotFromConcentrate real cider or perry at the bar.

values.heading: Last week of Cider and Perry Month
values.note: There is still time to try a real cider or perry.

values.heading: Thanks for a month of real cider
values.note: Thank you to every pub and producer who joined in this July.

campaigns.name: Good Beer Guide launch
campaigns.summary: Publication day for the next edition of CAMRA's Good Beer Guide, usually a Thursday in late September. Branches hold launch events and celebrate the pubs that made it in.

values.heading: Good Beer Guide {edition} launch
values.body:
Join us on {start} to celebrate the new Guide.
Pick up a copy and raise a glass to the pubs that made it in.

campaigns.name: CAMRA Members' Weekend and AGM
campaigns.summary: CAMRA's annual gathering in April: the AGM, Conference, National Executive election results and the Members' Bar, in a different host city each year.

values.heading: See you at Members' Weekend
values.body:
{dates} {where}.
The AGM, Conference and the Members' Bar.

campaigns.name: CAMRA's birthday
campaigns.summary: CAMRA was founded on 16 March 1971. A good excuse to thank members and invite new ones.

values.heading: Happy {ordinal} birthday, CAMRA
values.note: Campaigning for pubs, pints and people since 16 March 1971.

benefits.detail: on the pubs and beers we champion

campaigns.name: Tryanuary
campaigns.summary: An independent campaign, running since 2015 and supported by SIBA, that asks people to try a new beer, pub or brewery in January instead of going dry.

values.heading: Try something new this January
values.note: Support pubs and breweries through the quietest month: try a new beer, pub or brewery.

campaigns.name: Beer Day Britain
campaigns.summary: The UK's national beer day, every 15 June (the day Magna Carta was sealed). The National Cheers to Beer toast is at 7pm.

values.note: Join the National Cheers to Beer at 7pm.

values.heading: Cheers to Beer
values.note: Raise a glass at your local at 7pm for the National Cheers to Beer.

campaigns.name: World Cider Day
campaigns.summary: An international day for cider every 3 June, started by German cider houses in 2013.

values.heading: Happy World Cider Day
values.note: Ask for a real cider or perry at the bar.

campaigns.name: International IPA Day
campaigns.summary: A worldwide day for India pale ale, on the first Thursday of August.

values.heading: Happy IPA Day
values.note: Which IPA are you raising today?

campaigns.name: International Beer Day
campaigns.summary: A worldwide celebration of beer and the people who brew and serve it, on the first Friday of August.

values.heading: Happy International Beer Day
values.note: Raise a glass to the brewers and the bar staff.

campaigns.name: Cask Ale Week
campaigns.summary: The industry's annual celebration of cask beer, run by Cask Marque and supported by CAMRA. Ten days in late September (17 to 27 September in 2026).

values.note: Celebrate Britain's national drink at your local.

values.heading: Cask Ale Week
values.note: Try a pint of cask at one of these pubs.

values.heading: Thanks for celebrating cask
values.note: Thank you to every pub and brewery that joined in.

campaigns.name: International Stout Day
campaigns.summary: A worldwide day for stout and porter, on the first Thursday of November.

values.heading: Happy International Stout Day
values.note: Stout or porter: what is on the bar near you?

campaigns.name: Small Business Saturday
campaigns.summary: The UK's day for supporting small, local businesses, on the first Saturday of December. Independent pubs and breweries are small businesses too.

values.heading: Shop small, drink local
values.note: Your local pub is a small business too. Pop in this Small Business Saturday.

values.heading: Happy Burns Night
values.note: Haggis, neeps and a pint of Scottish ale.

campaigns.name: St David's Day
campaigns.summary: The patron saint's day of Wales, 1 March.

values.heading: Happy St David's Day
values.note: Raise a glass of Welsh beer or cider at your local.

campaigns.name: St Patrick's Day
campaigns.summary: The patron saint's day of Ireland, 17 March.

values.heading: Happy St Patrick's Day
values.note: Stout, porter or red ale: raise a glass at your local.

campaigns.name: St George's Day
campaigns.summary: The patron saint's day of England, 23 April.

values.heading: Happy St George's Day
values.note: Raise a glass of English ale at your local.

campaigns.name: St Andrew's Day
campaigns.summary: The patron saint's day of Scotland, 30 November.

values.heading: Happy St Andrew's Day
values.note: Raise a glass of Scottish ale at your local.
